question: Why does the loop start at i = 1 instead of i = 0?
choices: The first magnet is already read into prev before the loop, so only the other n - 1 are read inside it
Index 0 is skipped because the first magnet never forms a group
Reading from index 0 would overflow the string
The count must start at 0 and index 0 would make it 1
explanation: The first string is read before the loop and group starts at 1, so the loop only handles the remaining n - 1 strings.
